distribution_model.detail: Online auction marketplaces (GovDeals, etc.) selling surplus assets directly to business and public bidders; sellers consign assets.

market_position.detail: Surplus and excess assets sold via auction at competitive prices, below new-equipment cost.

notes: Business-to-business marketplace; consumer facets fit loosely, and categories reflect auctioned surplus goods.

product_category.detail: Surplus industrial equipment, vehicles, IT equipment, and retail and consumer goods inventory sold at online auction.

purchase_frequency.detail: Buyers bid opportunistically on surplus lots as available.

sub_sector.value: online surplus asset auction marketplaces; reverse logistics and asset disposition
